subject.title: feat(ui): merge voice and video talk into one button with in-call camera toggle

question: Should Control UI intentionally remove direct video-talk start and require users to begin voice talk before enabling the camera?
rationale: This is a user-facing interaction and camera-permission timing change with no compatibility mode; source review cannot determine whether that UX tradeoff is the repository’s intended product direction.

options.title: Adopt the in-call camera model
options.body: Keep the single launcher and lazy camera toggle, provided real browser evidence and current-head checks confirm the complete flow.

options.title: Preserve direct video start
options.body: Retain a distinct video-start entry point if immediate camera permission is an intentional supported workflow for existing users.

options.title: Pause for UX calibration
options.body: Hold the PR until a Control UI owner confirms the preferred launch and permission model.

recommendation.title: Adopt the in-call camera model
recommendation.body: Keep the single launcher and lazy camera toggle, provided real browser evidence and current-head checks confirm the complete flow.

likelyOwner.reason: The available commits show direct ownership of the proposed realtime-talk workflow, though current-main ownership history could not be confirmed.
